## Featured Engineering Systems
- **Enterprise Banking DMS & Digital Onboarding**: Air-gapped Go (Chi, pgx, raw SQL) Device Management System managing 40k+ corporate IoT terminals over MQTT and WebSockets with menu-level Casbin RBAC, OWASP zero critical pen-test findings, and 90% SQL latency reduction (9s to 900ms).
- **Hospital Queue Management System (QMS)**: Prefix-based global sequencing queue orchestration and real-time signage for Medistra Hospital and BitHealth (BIH) with 99.9% production availability.
- **SASI SIMKlinik (Clinic & EMR Platform)**: Dual-binary Go platform (`clinic-core-api` and `qms-queue-engine`) sharing PostgreSQL across 6 isolated schemas, compliant with Permenkes 24/2022, SATUSEHAT, and BPJS bridging.
- **Carbon Manufacturing ERP (crbnos/carbon)**: Merged upstream PR #866 (async group member search & prefetch caching), PR #1002 (AI-powered PDF extraction pipeline with Inngest across 20+ form endpoints), and PR #682 (company-isolated private buckets with signed URLs).
- **Golang Clean Architecture & API Blueprint**: Reference Go DDD starter with dependency injection, automated migrations, and 85%+ SQLMock unit test coverage.
